document_api_meta.title: Submit Strikethrough Price
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Submit external pricing information for a product's SKUs so that TikTok Shop can verify the product's list price for use as a strikethrough price. If the submitted information is approved, the verified list price may be displayed as the strikethrough price when a discount applies.

Submitted pricing information expires 90 days after submission and must be resubmitted to continue supporting strikethrough price display.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

request_body_param.name: external_product_id
request_body_param.desc: An external product identifier used on an external ecommerce platform. This value must match the `external_product_id` used when the product was created.

request_body_param.name: skus
request_body_param.desc: A list of SKUs whose external pricing information is submitted for verification. All SKU IDs must belong to the product identified by `product_id`.

request_body_param.name: ^external_retail_price
request_body_param.desc: The SKU retail price on the external ecommerce platform.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc: The retail price amount. The valid range is 0.01 to 7600.

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc: The ISO 4217 currency code. The supported value is `USD`.

request_body_param.name: ^external_sku_id
request_body_param.desc: An external SKU identifier used on an external ecommerce platform. This value must match the `external_sku_id` used when the SKU was created.

request_body_param.name: ^external_transaction_price
request_body_param.desc: The highest actual transaction price recorded for the SKU on the external ecommerce platform during the past 90 days.

request_body_param.name: ^^amount
request_body_param.desc: The transaction price amount. The valid range is 0.01 to 7600, and the value must be equal to or greater than the list price specified when the product was created or edited.

request_body_param.name: ^^currency
request_body_param.desc: The ISO 4217 currency code. The supported value is `USD`.

request_body_param.name: ^^image
request_body_param.desc: A reference to a previously uploaded image resource that proves the highest transaction price, such as an order or invoice screenshot. Mask all customer information before uploading the image.

request_body_param.name: ^^^uri
request_body_param.desc: The image URI returned by the Upload Product Image API when the image is uploaded with the `CERTIFICATION_IMAGE` use case.

request_body_param.name: ^^transaction_time
request_body_param.desc: The RFC 3339 time when the highest transaction price was recorded. The time must include a timezone and be within the 90 days before the request.

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc: The SKU ID generated by TikTok Shop.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: ^errors
response_param.desc: Item-level failures for SKUs that could not be submitted. The array is empty when every requested SKU is accepted for verification.

response_param.name: ^^code
response_param.desc: The stable business failure code for this SKU.

response_param.name: ^^detail
response_param.desc: Information that identifies the failed SKU.

response_param.name: ^^^sku_id
response_param.desc: The TikTok Shop SKU ID for which submission failed.

response_param.name: ^^message
response_param.example: The external retail price is invalid. Provide an amount from 0.01 to 7600.
response_param.desc: A human-readable description of the failure and the action needed to correct it.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

request_path_param.name: product_id
request_path_param.desc: The product ID in TikTok Shop.
